facts.fact: Government ministries, departments and agencies use the National Data Centre, which Huawei built and which Huawei, the Ministry of Information and ESCOM oversee, to hold clients' data and services on 78 virtual machines, so critical information stays in the country rather than offshore; the article gives no date other than its publication date of 2024-02-10.

note: No owner fact: the article names overseeing partners (Huawei, Ministry of Information, ESCOM) but does not state who owns the centre.
